trigger: Retained case E and F reports disagree on whether the installable NumPy declaration in requirements.txt counts as software inclusion under must/003. Case E's friction explicitly identifies this ambiguity.

review_basis.must/003: External software is included in the environment or linked as submodules within the project boundary.
review_basis.must/010: All software dependencies belong in the environment specification rather than relying on pre-installed tools.
review_basis.must/015: Environment specifications enable others to attempt exact environment replication.
review_basis.should/007: Environment artifacts are archived within the research object where possible.

clarification: An installable package declaration in a delivered environment specification counts as inclusion for must/003 without physical package vendoring. Dependency completeness, exact environment identity, and archived binaries are distinct checks; missing version pins alone do not establish incompleteness.
validation: Independent reviewer read the local pinned item text and the retained E/F reports and friction. This supports the interpretation's coherence; it is not measured evidence that a fresh assessor will follow the final wording.
historical_verdicts: Original E/F outputs and their disagreement are retained unchanged; no retrospective regrading.
